description: List the credential's staged import sessions, newest first — the way to FIND an importSessionId when you don't have one. Every other tool in this family (get_import_session, set_import_mapping, commit_import_session, rollback_import_session) needs the id, and create_import_session returns it exactly once, so start here whenever a customer asks about "the import I ran" — especially before a rollback, where the id is what stands between them and undoing a bad import. Returns per session: id, kind, source (Staged upload vs Inline lineage from import_historical_sales_orders — inline rows have no file fields by design), status, file name/size/rowCount, totalOrders/committedOrders/failedOrders, and the created/committed/expires timestamps — no file contents, profile, or validation report (call get_import_session for those). Optional status filter (AwaitingUpload, Uploaded, Validated, Previewed, Committing, Committed, Failed, Cancelled, RolledBack); paged (Total pre-paging + limit/offset, default 25, max 100). Staged sessions live 7 days; Inline lineage sessions keep their year-long rollback window, so both recent uploads and still-rollbackable inline imports appear here.

status.description: Optional status filter (case-insensitive): AwaitingUpload, Uploaded, Validated, Previewed, Committing, Committed, Failed, Cancelled, RolledBack. Omit for every status.

name: list_import_sessions
